plugins.description: Two agentic workflows for Claude Code, driven by one spec.md: story-driven delivery with gates (/create-prd, /create-story, /implement-story, /implement-epic, /close-story) and goal-driven pursuit against an executable yardstick (/create-goal, /pursue-goal).
